section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Center Support Assembly)

content.description: Illustration showing brake hub being held in a vise with soft jaws while flattening ears with a chisel

content.text: (e) Hold the brake hub in a vise with soft jaws, and flatten the ears with a chisel.
(f) Check to make sure that the retainer is centered.
Check that the sliding surface of disc is not worn or burnt. If the disc is worn or burnt, replace all discs.
Then check that the sliding surfaces of plate and flange are not worn or burnt.

NOTE: Do allow the discs to dry out.
Prepare new discs by soaking them at least two hours in ATF.
1. INSTALL TWO OIL SEAL RINGS AND ONE WAY CLUTCH ASSEMBLY ON SUN GEAR

content.description: Illustration showing installation of oil seal rings and one way clutch assembly on sun gear

content.text: 2. INSTALL THREE OIL SEAL RINGS ON CENTER SUPPORT
Spread the rings apart and slip them into the groove. Hook both ends by hand.

content.description: Illustration showing spreading oil seal rings apart to install them into groove on center support

content.text: 4. INSTALL NO. 1 BRAKE PISTON IN CENTER SUPPORT
Press the No. 1 brake piston into the center support with the cup side up, being careful not to damage the O-rings.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of No. 1 brake piston into center support assembly
